title: A page database write never opens a permission card in a cloud session
why: R21, owner 19:01 CST Nov 10: "ive found repos in cloud sessions of triage of repos requesting for me to permit this when it should just always be allowed this needs to be fixed too". The card reads "Allow Claude to use db write (claude-artifacts)?". settings.json permissions.allow on main 2d6f67f7c already holds mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write and the other db tools, yet the card shows. Cause unproven: the cloud tool is named ArtifactData and no entry names it, or auto mode asks despite the entry. Owner 19:04 CST: "claude also added new artifact commands that start with db (surf the web) that im guessing we need to add too now to the allow list". ArtifactData has nine actions (get, list, query, profiles, set, update, str_replace, delete, batch); settings.json allows six mcp__claude-artifacts__ tools. Lane: reproduce the card in a cloud session first; read the real tool names from that session's tool listing, never a guess; allow every page database action under each name the card checks; a test proves no card. call_judge.py and guard.py still judge each page write. It stalls triage itself, so it may go before R13. Owner 19:13 CST, with a card from the Degen cloud coordinator: "even this artifact write needed my permission". That card names `claude-artifacts: db write`, which settings.json already allows, so a missing name is not the whole cause. Owner 19:15 CST, a third card (home triage, one db write with 18 set ops): "only allow once for these". The card offers no "always allow", which points at a claude.ai consent card that no settings file lifts. The lane checks that first, and says so if the only fix is outside this repo. The page hooks (call_judge.py and the guard.py page rules) match ArtifactData only, so they never fire on mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write. Open PR #2549 (artifact-guard-matcher-names) adds those names and lands with this fix. Owner 19:27 CST: home triage batched page writes about 100 per call and each batch still needed approval ("thats still not optimal"). That session listed two tool names the allow list lacks: mcp__claude-artifacts__db_usage and mcp__claude-artifacts__read_artifact. Interim rule (plan R21 point 2) until the fix lands: a page writer sends page writes from the main session as batch calls of up to 50 writes each (one card per call), never from a subagent.
